# Balance report

Generated by `npm run balance -- --seeds 30 --warps 10` at commit `147f108` on Node 24.22.2 (linux x64). The bot (`scripts/bot.ts`) plays the flagship; drones, haulers and construction drones use their built-in AI. While a system's respec window is open it picks one doctrine pair from the save seed (seed modulo 3 chooses fleet, haul or focus; seed parity chooses that pair's side) and leaves the other two unpicked. At each warp the bot takes the richest of the candidate routes (most opening rocks × richness, lower hazard on a tie). On that same tick it delivers spare bank resources to the Horizon Gate, leaving the fuel the warp needs; spare Horizon Data is included from system 7 on. The flagship also pings its sensors whenever they are ready and flies to revealed derelicts to claim their salvage. Hazards: normal. Times are sim time (m:ss). Cells show median (min–max) across seeds.

## Opening (system 1)

Every warp starts a fresh run (new fleet, new loadout), so the opening asks what the player should have built before leaving system 1, not what a long stay would reach. The target is the first drone and the flagship's tier-2 laser, both before the first warp, in at least 80% of seeds; the other rows are for context. The bot warps as soon as the bank holds the fuel, so it is the impatient player.

## Active-play share (#46)

Active-play share is `(flagship unloads + contract rewards) / all income`, all income being flagship + drones + haulers + contracts. Contract rewards count as active play because the player earns them by mining, breaking and delivering; haulers (miner skims and outpost output, #39) count as idle play alongside drones. Target: **≥ 40% through the mid-game** (systems 3–6).

- Mid-game pooled (income-weighted, 120 seed-warps): **56%** (flagship 42% · drones 19% · haulers 25% · contracts 14%) — **PASS**
- Mid-game across seed-warps: median 55%, 40%–83%
- Per system (median, min–max): 3: 57% (40%–83%) · 4: 58% (41%–74%) · 5: 55% (46%–74%) · 6: 55% (46%–69%)

## Automation by the early game (#206)

Refining, outposts and haulers are the second pillar of the game, so they should show up before the mid-game, not at system 6. Targets: refined alloy and a working outpost, both by system 4, in at least 50% of seeds; and a median hauler share of income above 0% in every system from 4 to 6.

## Fleet utilisation (#207)

The fleet cap (drones and haulers together) is a headline progression stat, so it should be in use well before the late game. Fleet at warp is the number of ships in the fleet on the last tick before the warp. The cap is not meant to be aspirational: target a median of **≥ 4 ships at warp in every system from 4 to 6**. More automation lowers active play, so the active-play target above must still hold.

## Horizon Gate (#177)

The gate is optional: the bot still warps as soon as the bank holds the fuel. On that tick it pays whatever the current stage still wants from resources that would be left behind. Spare Horizon Data, the amount that could not buy a perk, is paid only when leaving system 7 or later, so the delivery does not delay the perks the mid-game rows measure. The system column is the one the bot was leaving. A stage the run never finished is counted in “not reached”.
